message: Boundary Allow statement 'AllowDataCatalogRead' grants cross-account-capable actions (glue:GetDatabase, glue:GetDatabases, glue:GetTable) without aws:ResourceAccount condition. The created role could access Glue catalogs in other accounts if cross-account resource policies permit it.

Boundary Allow statement 'AllowLakeFormationAccess' grants cross-account-capable actions (lakeformation:GetDataAccess) without aws:ResourceAccount condition. The created role could access Lake Formation resources in other accounts.
